subject: general
question: Which of the following lies under the jurisdiction of the Central Government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cantonment Board**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Cantonment Board is a civic administration body in India under the control of the Ministry of Defence.
 
• It is established for the administration of civilian areas in the cantonments.
 
• The primary duty of the Cantonment Board is to ensure the overall development of the cantonment area and provide essential services to the residents.
 
• They are responsible for maintaining proper sanitation, water supply, street lighting, and other civic amenities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **District Board**

 
 
• The District Board or Zila Parishad is a local government body at the district level in India.
 
• It oversees the administration of rural areas in a district and works towards the development of these regions.
 
• It is under the jurisdiction of the state government.
 
 
 
• **Municipal Board**
 
 
• The Municipal Board or Nagar Palika is an urban local body responsible for the administration of a city or town.
 
• It looks after civic amenities like water supply, sewage, roads, and street lighting.
 
• It operates under the jurisdiction of the state government.
 
 
 
• **Town Area**
 
 
• A Town Area is a smaller urban area with a local governing body responsible for basic civic administration.
 
• It is typically managed by a Town Area Committee and is under the jurisdiction of the state government.
